threshold_change: STONK remains the flagship attention asset, but price persistence has broken while Raydium's user growth, staking, DEX activity, fee generation and fee-funded RAY buybacks are simultaneously accelerating. This constitutes a leadership rotation toward the infrastructure/value-capture layer rather than a new Solana-wide regime.
why_flows_appear_speculative: The acceleration is concentrated in launchpad/new-asset trading and tokenized-equity/custom-pair activity rather than broad Solana beta. Raydium itself reports no token incentives in the measured periods, while StonkFun traffic is fee-paying launch and swap activity. This does not eliminate bot activity, but it avoids the explicit points/quest/volume-reward contamination seen in competing ecosystems such as BNC4.

leadership_rotation_evidence.ray_buyback_note: Largest reported single-day RAY buyback to date at observation time, funded by protocol swap fees.

wallet_quality_evidence.reason: No new independently funded selective-wallet convergence on RAY was established in this scan. The principal accumulation signal is protocol-driven open-market buyback demand, which is economically meaningful but is not treated as smart-wallet evidence.

narrative_news_evidence: Raydium is capturing activity from StonkFun LaunchLab custom pairs and a growing set of tokenized U.S. equities and other nonstandard assets. The narrative is therefore directly composable with Raydium liquidity and fee economics rather than relying mainly on influencer promotion.

liquidity_executability.comment: RAY has materially deeper executable liquidity than STONK and is broadly traded across centralized and decentralized venues.

structural_gate.mint_authority: disabled/revoked per Raydium documentation and secondary tokenomics review
structural_gate.ongoing_emissions: approximately 1.9M RAY/year from pre-allocated mining reserve
structural_gate.major_risk: Large historical reserve/allocation base remains relevant to dilution analysis even though current emissions are from an existing capped reserve rather than new mint authority.

major_uncertainties: No high-confidence selective-wallet convergence on RAY yet.
STONK holder count is still rising quickly despite its price decline, so this could be temporary relative-performance rotation rather than durable displacement.
Launchpad activity naturally contains bots and short-horizon churn even without explicit points incentives.
Current macro tape is risk-off, which can distort relative token performance and shorten speculative regimes.
why_it_matters_now: The prior sequence was RAY infrastructure confirmation followed by STONK asset-level leadership. The new evidence reverses that ordering: STONK attention and holder growth persist but price persistence has failed, while Raydium's underlying usage, staking, volume and fee-funded token accumulation are strengthening. The framework therefore upgrades RAY as the current cleaner leader of the same speculative sub-regime.
rejected_or_discounted_competing_signals: BNB Chain: very strong DEX acceleration, but BNC4/Four.meme explicitly rewards volume leadership with buybacks, contaminating the core metric.
Base/LAPTOP: rejected at asset level because the launch was dominated by extreme sniper-driven price distortion, thin liquidity, concentrated founder allocation and airdrop-related supply.
Robinhood Chain/PONS: ecosystem activity remains strong, but PONS is down materially from its recent high and no new leadership upgrade was established in this scan.
Monad: spot DEX volume remains down week over week and 24h inflows are negative despite perps growth.
Sui/Avalanche: weekly growth remains notable but current daily spot run rates do not show a fresh acceleration threshold.
